mentions.name: Snipara
mentions.description: A context and memory infrastructure system that preserves LLM context and project memory, letting users switch LLMs or invite someone to work on a code project without losing context. Free to use and installable via the npx create-snipara command.
mentions.problem: Context and memory are lost when changing LLMs or adding a new person to a code project.
mentions.audience: Developers working on code projects who switch LLMs or bring collaborators in
mentions.source_excerpt:
A context and memory infrastructure system so I can change LLM or invite someone to work on a code project without losing context and memory :
https://www.snipara.com
